name: PROJECT: Hecarim
creator: kaizen
description:
**Features:**

   - Custom model and textures

   - Support for all quality settings

   - Custom Voice-over for all languages

   - Custom loading screen

   - Custom SFX
   - Custom VFX

   - Latest augments straight from corpo ripper docs

   - 3 years of hard work (just kidding, updated it in one afternoon)

Many people have been asking me to update my old mods, particularly Project Hecarim. It was getting broken every patch, I didn't wanna deal with it. But now, thanks to Divine's modding tools, fixing it is not only piss easy, it's mostly future proof, too! While at was at it, I decided to give it a whole new entire VFX suite, so the wait can be at least a little sweetened. Enjoy!
